architectures.name: Gateway with shared counter store
architectures.summary: A gateway checks a shared in-memory store using atomic operations for each request.
architectures.bestWhen: Accuracy across many gateway nodes matters.
drawbacks: Store is on the critical path.

architectures.name: Local token buckets with periodic sync
architectures.summary: Each node enforces a local share of the limit and syncs usage periodically.
architectures.bestWhen: Latency is critical and small overshoot is acceptable.
